facts.fact: NITDA says it has trained 200 participants in ICT training for people with disabilities, held in Abuja in 2014 to 2016 and Gombe in 2017, and has adopted it as an annual programme.
facts.system: NITDA ICT Training for People With Disabilities

facts.fact: NITDA lists the 3 Million Tech Talents (3MTT) programme, run with partners and training providers, to build technical talent in skills such as software development, data and cybersecurity.
